description.value: Whenever the red mage enhances his weapon using his arcane pool, he can spend 1 additional point from his arcane pool to add the returning, throwing, and spell hurling abilities to the list of available weapon special abilities. When the red mage throws a weapon enhanced by his arcane pool and hits a foe, he regains 1 arcane pool point. The red mage can regain a number of arcane pool points per day equal to his Charisma modifier in this way. If he throws his held weapon and draws another in the same round, he can enhance the newly drawn weapon with his arcane pool as a free action instead of a swift action.

system.source: Final Fantasy d20 - Red Mage (Ruby Arcana)
